If Performing an Internal Review, Eviden: Review vendor tiering, questionnaires, reports, contracts, unresolved issues, and reassessment cadence.

If Performing an Internal Review, Eviden: Review completion rates, simulation metrics, repeat-failure handling, role-based training, and improvement trends.

If Performing an Internal Review, Eviden: Review committee charter, reporting packages, escalation criteria, incident notification timelines, and evidence of oversight actions.
